name: moving-border
title: Moving Border Button
description: A pill button on a translucent dark slate fill with a white label. A small blue glow travels the full perimeter on a loop, so the edge is always lit in one moving spot.
use: A primary button should keep drawing the eye with a slow glowing rim.
avoid: You need a strong focus state, or the glow must stop for motion-sensitive users.
a11y: It is a real button with a text label, but there is no visible focus ring and the glow never stops for reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded pill button on black, filled in a translucent dark slate with a faint darker border and a white medium-weight label reading Moving Border. A soft blue highlight glows on one part of the rim at a time.
behaves: A blue radial glow circles the entire perimeter continuously, completing a lap roughly every three seconds, so the bright spot travels along the rim without a pause. The fill and label never move.
customise: children is the label, and borderRadius, as, containerClassName, borderClassName and duration are props. The blue glow colour and the 30% corner radii are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One SVG rect path sampled every frame to move a single small glow.
